description.value: Old Town Ice Cream is an ice cream shop located in the historic downtown core of Ladysmith on Vancouver Island. Ladysmith's First Avenue is a heritage commercial strip popular with cyclists riding the E&N corridor or touring the island, making a sweet stop here a natural fit for a long ride.
